nodes.text:
Acute respiratory tract infections (ARTIs) result in (LRTIs) Numerous viruses, as coronavirus, influenza virus, human respiratory syncytial virus (hRSV), others, are responsible for incidence of ARTIs.
HMPV an enveloped, non-segmented, negative-stranded virus belongs to subfamily Pneumovirinae;

nodes.author: BagaiDr
nodes.text: HMPV genome (nearly 13 kb) contains eight genes encode 9 proteins, namely nucleoprotein (N), phosphoprotein (P), matrix protein (M), fusion protein (F), matrix-2 proteins (M2-1, M2-2), small hydrophobic (SH) protein, glycoprotein (G), large (L) polymerase protein; to genetic features of F and G genes, HMPV strains prevalent worldwide could be classified into 4 genotypes (A1, A2, B1 and B2), further divided into six lineages (A1, A2a, A2b, A2c, B1, B2),

co-prevalence of several sub-genotypes or sub-lineages of HMPV frequently reported. relationship between disease severity and HMPV genotype;
HMPV effective vaccine or antiviral drug for treating or preventing HMPV infection is not licensed. HMPV with one million outpatient clinic visits with clinical symptoms of ARTIs, disease caused by HMPV infection, threats to health of > 86% of children < 5 years worldwide

nodes.text: epidemiological results of 17 studies show, no significant relationship between gender and HMPV infection, average positive rate of HMPV infection among male and female was 3.48% & 5.11%; , positive rate of HMPV-infected inpatients (3.56%) was not significantly different between outpatients (3.22%).

nodes.text: genetic characteristics of HMPV, divided into six lineages (A1, A2a, A2b, A2c, B1, B2).  relationships between pathogenicity and different HMPV lineages not explored, geographical distribution of different HMPV lineages in China. total of 1253 HMPV gene sequences (G, F, M, or complete genome) summarized in 19 articles to explore genetic features of HMPV strains prevalent in China. 282 HMPV strains belonged to A1, A2, A2b, A2C, B1, B2 lineages, which accounted for 0.64%, 2.79%, 43.42%, 6.78%, 23.86%, 22.51%. A2b, B1, B2 strains are the predominant lineages prevalent in China, while HMPV lineages prevalent in different provinces/regions in China are diverse. A2C predominant lineage prevalent in Henan province; B1 and B2, but not A2b or A2C, predominated in Zhejian
